BLD001.name: Building Overlap
BLD001.description: Positive-area overlap between two building polygon footprints detected by PostGIS.
BLD001.recommendation: Compare both footprints against the survey/plan source and remove the unintended overlap; if a shared wall or valid adjacency exists, snap the boundaries so polygons only touch, never overlap.

BLD002.name: Duplicate Buildings
BLD002.description: Two building rows share an exactly identical geometry (EWKB match).
BLD002.recommendation: Keep one authoritative building row and merge or delete the duplicate after confirming its attributes.
BLD002.priority_hint: Deduplicate before counting or aggregating features.

BLD003.name: Invalid Geometry
BLD003.description: Building geometry failed PostGIS validity checks (ST_IsValid).
BLD003.recommendation: Repair the geometry (e.g. ST_MakeValid) and re-validate; if the source data is genuinely malformed, correct it at the source.
BLD003.priority_hint: Invalid geometry can break spatial operations — fix first.

BLD004.name: Missing Geometry
BLD004.description: Building row has NULL or empty geometry.
BLD004.recommendation: Provide the missing footprint geometry from the authoritative source, or remove the row if it is not a building.
BLD004.priority_hint: Features without geometry cannot be mapped or analyzed.

RD001.name: Road Overshoot
RD001.description: Heuristic topology candidate (5 m tolerance): a road line continues past its junction instead of terminating on another road.
RD001.recommendation: Visually confirm the junction; if it is a true overshoot, trim the line to the intersection; otherwise mark the candidate as a false positive.
RD001.priority_hint: Review candidates before batch-editing road topology.

RD002.name: Road Undershoot
RD002.description: Heuristic topology candidate (5 m tolerance): a road endpoint stops short of the road it should connect to.
RD002.recommendation: Visually confirm the gap; if it is a true undershoot, extend the line to snap to the junction; otherwise mark the candidate as a false positive.
RD002.priority_hint: Review candidates before batch-editing road topology.

RD003.name: Duplicate Roads
RD003.description: Two road rows share an exactly identical geometry (EWKB match).
RD003.recommendation: Keep one authoritative road row and merge or delete the duplicate after confirming its attributes.

RD004.name: Invalid Geometry
RD004.description: Road geometry failed PostGIS validity checks (ST_IsValid).
RD004.recommendation: Repair the geometry (e.g. ST_MakeValid) and re-validate; correct malformed source data upstream.
RD004.priority_hint: Invalid geometry can break spatial operations — fix first.

RD005.name: Missing Geometry
RD005.description: Road row has NULL or empty geometry.
RD005.recommendation: Provide the missing road geometry from the authoritative source, or remove the row if it is not a road.
RD005.priority_hint: Features without geometry cannot be mapped or analyzed.

GIS001.name: Missing/Wrong CRS
GIS001.description: Layer CRS is missing or does not match the expected EPSG code for the delivery.
GIS001.recommendation: Set or reproject the layer to the expected CRS before further processing.
GIS001.priority_hint: A wrong CRS invalidates every downstream coordinate.

GIS002.name: Invalid Coordinates
GIS002.description: Coordinates fall outside valid longitude/latitude ranges for EPSG:4326.
GIS002.recommendation: Reproject or fix the affected coordinates; verify the source CRS assumption.
GIS002.priority_hint: Out-of-range coordinates usually mean a CRS mix-up.

GIS003.name: Missing Required Attributes
GIS003.description: A column required by the GeoSA configuration (meyaar_required_attributes) is missing on the layer or row.
GIS003.recommendation: Populate the required column from the authoritative source, or formally waive the requirement.
GIS003.priority_hint: Required attributes gate downstream compliance checks.

GIS004.name: Wrong Data Type
GIS004.description: A column value does not match the expected data type from meyaar_expected_types.
GIS004.recommendation: Cast or clean the column so values match the expected type.
GIS004.priority_hint: Type mismatches break queries and aggregation.

GIS005.name: Invalid Attribute Values
GIS005.description: A column value is not in the allowed-value list from meyaar_allowed_values.
GIS005.recommendation: Correct the value to one of the allowed values or extend the allowed list after domain approval.
GIS005.priority_hint: Standardized values keep the dataset interoperable.
